title: Onboarding & Interview Debriefs - Weekly Sync 2026-05-19
content:
Attendees: Sofia Martinez (notes), Liam Nguyen, Priya Kapoor, Daniel Kim, Ava Chen
Date: 2026-05-19
Duration: 45m
Location: Zoom / #eng-hiring Slack

Agenda:
- Quick hiring funnel update
- Interview debriefs (3 candidates)
- Onboarding status for new hires + blockers
- Team health flags and action items

1) Hiring funnel snapshot (TL;DR)
- Open reqs: Backend SWE (2), Infra/SRE (1), Frontend (1), Applied ML infra (1)
- Active candidates in loop: 14 (phone screens 6, take-home 4, onsites 4)
- Week-over-week: +2 candidate pipeline (recruiter outreach improving), conversion from screen->onsite still a bottleneck (35%)
- Priority: fill Backend SWE (product infra) and Infra/SRE by end of Q2

2) Interview debriefs
- Candidate A: Alice Park — Backend SWE (take-home + onsite)
  - Panel: Priya, Daniel, Liam
  - Strengths: strong systems design, clear latency/cost tradeoff thinking, good production debugging examples
  - Concerns: limited exposure to GPU-inference stack (no direct inference infra experience); take-home had minor test edge cases missed
  - Rating: 7/10
  - Recommendation: Proceed to final onsite (focus on runtime/serving questions + pairing exercise), hiring manager to confirm priority.
  - Action: Priya to schedule pairing with runtime lead (target: 05-25).

- Candidate B: Marcus Lee — Infra/SRE (onsite)
  - Panel: Ava, Sofia, external SRE consultant (interviewing loop)
  - Strengths: solid incident response, distributed systems experience, Kubernetes internals knowledge
  - Concerns: answer depth on GPU scheduling and accelerator-aware autoscaling felt surface-level; two references did not emphasize long-term infra ownership
  - Rating: 5/10
  - Recommendation: Do not extend offer at this time. Keep in pipeline for IC SRE roles; ask recruiter to source candidates with explicit accelerator orchestration experience.
  - Action: Liam to update rejection note and flag required skills for new search (JIRA-ENG-2184).

- Candidate C: Zoe Alvarez — Frontend SWE (onsite)
  - Panel: Daniel, Sofia, product PM
  - Strengths: polished UI/UX thinking, strong React + TypeScript experience, good cross-team communication examples
  - Concerns: limited exposure to large-scale telemetry instrumentation, will need ramp on internal SDKs
  - Rating: 8/10
  - Recommendation: Strong hire for frontend role; prioritize offer for candidate (comp package to be aligned with frontend ladder).
  - Action: Sofia to draft offer template and loop in People Ops (target: 05-21).

3) Onboarding updates (new hires + early ramp)
- Ethan Ross (SRE) — start date: 2026-05-25
  - Current status: paperwork complete, laptop requested (M1 Mac configured but team prefers Linux dev image).
  - Blockers: Linux workstation image not ready; infra team to provide VM image.
  - Action: Daniel to follow up with infra provisioning (target: 05-22).

- Nina Lopez (Platform Eng) — start date: 2026-06-01 (offer accepted)
  - Current status: onboarding plan drafted in CON-542; mentor assigned (Priya), 30/60/90 goals sketched.
  - Blockers: security KMS access needs ticket for KMS onboarding (security review pending).
  - Action: Priya to file access ticket with Security (target: 05-20).

- First-week plan highlights:
  - Day 1: welcome, paperwork, intro to codebase and infra; pairing session on day 2 with runtime team for context on serving runtime
  - Training: internal runbook + 2.5h recorded sessions on GPU infra; add short quiz to ensure baseline knowledge of cache/batching concepts.

4) Team health / observations
- Burnout signals: two ICs (backend team) reported high meetings this sprint and feel overloaded with on-call handoffs. We need to protect heads-down time for latency-critical infra work.
- Planned time off: Priya on PTO 06-03 to 06-07 (plan ahead for onboarding mentor coverage).
- Skip-level check-ins: schedule with Eng Manager group to gather anonymous feedback on ramp friction and documentation gaps (Sofia to run).
- Morale: positive around new front-end hire pipeline; concern about ongoing infra bug backlog affecting velocity.

5) Action items (owner — due)
- Priya: Schedule pairing session for Alice Park with runtime lead (05-25)
- Liam: Update candidate rejection notes and adjust job posting filter for accelerator scheduling experience (05-21)
- Sofia: Draft offer for Zoe Alvarez and coordinate comp with People Ops (05-21)
- Daniel: Provision Linux dev image/VM for Ethan Ross (05-22)
- Priya: File KMS onboarding ticket for Nina Lopez (05-20)
- Sofia: Run skip-level check-ins + summarize findings (05-29)

6) Misc notes / open questions
- Should we add a short "inference infra primer" recorded session to onboarding for all new hires joining infra-adjacent teams? (Proposal: 45min session + reading list) — agreed in principle, Priya to draft content outline.
- Re-evaluate sourcing channels for SRE candidates with accelerator experience (reach out to 3 new sourcers) — Liam to action.

Next sync: 2026-05-26 (same time)

Notes captured by: Sofia Martinez
Comments / corrections: please add inline in this doc or ping @sofia on Slack.
